page.overview:
Who is Pellas Mir'san?

Pellas Mir'san, known as the "Winter Blade" and the "Defender of Nocturne," is a venerable captain of the Salamanders Space Marines Chapter.

He has served as the commander of the 2nd Company for more than a century and a half. He is one of the oldest members of the Chapter still serving.

A legend amongst the Astartes of the Salamanders, the venerable Captain Pellas Mir'san is one of the oldest members of the Chapter still serving, which earned him the title of the "Winter Blade" amongst his fellow Battle-Brothers.

Captain Mir'san has served as the commander of the 2nd Company for more than one hundred and fifty standard years, and before that served as Chapter Champion for thirty years, remaining undefeated for his tenure.
